parties.petitioner: Atlanta Limited Thr. Its Managing Director
parties.respondent: Union Of India Represented By Chief Engineer Military Engineering Service

summary: Dispute over construction contract for Naval Air Station runway. Contract dated 16 November 1988 for completion within 21 months. Appellant claimed extension of time for waterlogged site and completion of 72% work by March 1992. Respondent terminated contract on 2 April 1992 without providing site access passes. Arbitrator awarded ₹25,96,87,442.89 favoring appellant. High Court Division Bench partially allowed Union of India's appeal by setting aside idle hire charges, tools/machinery value, time extension validity and illegal termination findings. Appeal challenged limited judicial interference scope in arbitral awards under Arbitration Act 1940.
